sections.title: Set the default language
sections.excerpt: Set the default language | The default language is the fallback locale used when a visitor has no matching localized content. Choose the primary audience language.

sections.title: Optionally assign a folder
sections.excerpt: Optionally assign a folder | Choose a folder to organize the draft in the Onboardings list, or leave it at the root level. The folder only affects organization and can be changed later.

sections.title: Add supported languages
sections.excerpt: Add supported languages | Add every locale you intend to publish so screens can carry localized copy from the start. You can extend this later, but planning it now avoids rework.

sections.title: Name the onboarding
sections.excerpt: Name the onboarding | Use a clear internal name so the draft is easy to find in the Onboardings list. The name is not shown to visitors.

sections.title: Choose the platform
sections.excerpt: Choose the platform | The platform controls the publish surface and runtime behavior. Web flows publish through Web Placement; pick it before selecting a theme.
